newsitem.title: GERMANY: German trade bids for free market grain exports.
newsitem.headline: German trade bids for free market grain exports.

text.p: German traders made bids to export 34,500 tonnes of free market wheat with a 21.87-22.97 Ecus a tonne rebate, state grain intervention board BLE said on Thursday.

Traders also sought to export 12,500 tonnes of free market barley with restitutions in a 30.95-36.32 Ecus range and 17,200 tonnes of free market rye exports, where the desired rebate was 31.07-35.49 Ecus.
The bids will be discussed at a weekly EU grain managers meeting later on today.
